differences: The README's MEG session design says the MEG2 retest has 36 practice trials; the files hold 9 (as in MEG3), which fits its 3-minute scan. The README says one participant's MEG1 recording stopped after trial 34; the events file still has key presses for trials 35 and 36 (the behavioural log was not part of the MEG recording). One participant's MEG3 control run used the MEG2 control sequences.

The two papers named on OpenMotor (Bonstrup 2019, 27 participants analysed, one retest the next day; Buch 2021, 30 participants, one session) describe other cohorts than this deposit (31 participants, retests about 24 h and 30 days later), and the deposit's README cites no paper; the numbers checked here are therefore the README's, not those of the papers.
